missing_policy: the denominator is the 24 planned units; a unit without a model-produced response is MISSING in the model metrics (never 0 or 1) and shown by call outcome; a refusal is never retried; only transport faults, lost responses, 429 and 5xx are retried within the fixed allowance; the frozen call cap (40) covers the 24 planned requests plus bounded resamples — raising it would be recorded, and the denominator never changes
